title: ack input
description: §6.6 — ack(envelopeId) -> ReturnReceipt. The sender funded it; the recipient pays nothing (P-16).

envelopeId.description: The AAD hash of §7.2, lowercase hex.

lane.description: Narrow the search to one lane. Optional: §6.6 reads the pending schedule from the lane's transaction operation, and the caller's lanes are found from consensus by §7.1's rule when this is absent.
